description: Elections Commission - R. W. N. W. B. Mirahawaththa was elected as the member of the Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Welimada Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local authority level, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
